## reference · AI platform citation patterns
* ChatGPT's top cited source is Wikipedia at 7.8% of total citations
* Google AI Overviews' top cited source is Reddit at 2.2% of total citations
* Perplexity's top cited source is Reddit at 6.6% of total citations
* Wikipedia accounts for 47.9% of citations among ChatGPT's top 10 most-cited sources
* Reddit accounts for 46.7% of citations among Perplexity's top 10 most-cited sources
* .com domains represent 80.41% of citations in ChatGPT
* .org domains represent 11.29% of citations in ChatGPT
* Country-specific domains (.uk, .au, .br, .ca) collectively represent about 3.5% of citations in ChatGPT
* Tech-focused TLDs (.io, .ai) show notable presence despite being newer domains
* Each AI platform requires a different approach to content optimization
* Diversify content across platforms based on AI platform preferences
* Focus on high-quality contributions to key platforms like Reddit and Wikipedia
* Active participation in Reddit communities is crucial for visibility
* Professional network engagement (LinkedIn) matters more for Google AI Overviews
Sources: https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/ai-platform-citation-patterns
